targets._doc: Phase 3b balance at Normal (tests/targets.test.ts): CPU QB against an all-CPU defense over every pass play and defense call. A throw 'goes to' the defender nearest the target receiver at the release. cbTargetShare counts CB1, CB2 and NB; outsideCbTargetShare only CB1 and CB2. intPerGame = interceptions per attempt x attemptsPerGame.

zoneCoverage._doc: Phase 3c (tests/coverage.test.ts): Cover 3 at Normal, every pass play (no runs, screens) x seeds, sampled at sampleTimes. A receiver inside the zone defender's area (landmark +- w, depth band yards past the LOS) is one sample; open = a perfect throw now beats every defender by openMargin s and nobody is in phase. maxOpenRate: the cap for that defender. maxStray: how far (yd, average) he may drift from his landmark before the throw.

surpriseBlitz._doc: Phase 3c (tests/blitz.test.ts): the user's LB1 blitzes straight at the QB in Cover 3 (not called by the scheme), CPU QB, every pass play (no screens) x seeds, Normal, average teams. sackRate: allowed range of sacks per snap; detect: allowed range (s) of the QB's mean time to notice the rusher after he triggers.

toss._doc: Phase 3d toss corridor (tests/tossBalance.test.ts): HB Toss, auto-run carrier, Normal, rheinstadt vs elbtal, every CPU coverage x seedsPerDefense. Average yards in [avgMin, avgMax], standard deviation in [sdMin, sdMax], tackles for loss in [tflMin, tflMax], runs of bigPlayYards+ at least bigPlayMin. Against the blitzes (Cover 1 Blitz, Cover 0, Fire Zone) with the front seven's strength / tackling / awareness + stoutFront (speed + half): TFL at least stoutBlitzTflMin and fewer yards than overall. Measured: 4.65 avg, sd 6.0, 15 % TFL, 4 % 20+; blitz + stout front 3.5 avg, 34 % TFL.
